questions.texte: This person helps sick people. Who is it?
This person teaches students. Who is it?
This person cooks food in a restaurant. Who is it?
This person flies an airplane. Who is it?

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences with the correct form of the verb in brackets: present simple or present continuous.

questions.texte: She ______ (work) in a hospital every day.
Listen! The teacher ______ (speak) to the class right now.
I ______ (not / have) a job at the moment.
He usually ______ (drive) to work, but today he ______ (take) the bus.
They ______ (build) a new school in our neighborhood this year.

enonce.texte:
Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) describing your current job or the job you would like to have in the future. Include the following information:

  • The name of the profession
  • Where you work
  • What you do every day
  • What you are doing this week

Use at least two present simple sentences and two present continuous sentences.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph describing your current or future job.
questions.reponse: I am a teacher. I work at a school in Yaoundé. I teach English to students every day. This week, I am preparing a special lesson about professions. I am also correcting exams. I love my job because I like helping students learn.

enonce.texte: Answer the following questions about your daily work routine or a typical day of a professional.

questions.texte: What time do you start work every day?
questions.reponse: I start work at 8:00 AM every day.

questions.texte: What are you doing at work this week?
questions.reponse: This week, I am working on a project.

questions.texte: What does your boss do every morning?
questions.reponse: My boss checks emails and has meetings every morning.

questions.texte: What is your colleague doing at the moment?
questions.reponse: My colleague is typing a report at the moment.

This person studies rocks and the earth's structure. Who is it?
This person represents people in court. Who is it?

enonce.texte:
Write a detailed job description for a position of your choice. Include the following sections:

  • Job title
  • Main responsibilities
  • Required skills
  • Workplace
  • Why someone should apply

Use at least 10 sentences and include both present simple and present continuous forms.

questions.reponse: Job Title: English Teacher. Main responsibilities: Teaching English to beginner students, preparing lesson plans, and evaluating students' progress. Required skills: Good communication skills, patience, and a degree in English or Education. Workplace: A language school in Douala. This week, we are hiring new teachers for our evening classes. We are looking for someone who is passionate about teaching and who can work well with young learners. The school is organizing a training session this month. If you enjoy helping others and want to work in a friendly environment, apply now!
